data.one_liner: Request location updates and send them to a background Dart function even when the app is killed.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that enables background location tracking and sends updates to a specified Dart function, continuing to work even if the application is killed or terminated by the OS. It provides options for meter filtering, Android notification customization, and restart configuration after device reboots.
use_when: You need to track location updates while the app is running in the background or killed.
You need to execute background Dart callbacks when a location update occurs.
avoid_when: You only need simple foreground-only geolocation without background persistence.
You want a fully declarative location-fetching widget.
strengths: Works when the app is killed on supported platforms.
Provides meter filtering and platform-specific location options.
weaknesses: Requires complex native setup steps as documented in the wiki.
Background execution handling can be prone to platform restrictions.
data.setup_notes: Requires following wiki instructions for platform-specific setup on Android and iOS, handling permissions, and handling background execution configurations.

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: A more standard and widely maintained geolocation plugin for Flutter, though background tracking setup varies.
